newsitem.title: KENYA: Stocks firmer in thin trade at Nairobi bourse.
newsitem.headline: Stocks firmer in thin trade at Nairobi bourse.

text.p: The Nairobi Stock Exchange (NSE) 20-share index rose on Friday as share prices improved despite thin volumes traded, brokers said.
The index rose 16.95 points to stand at 3047.55. Turnover was posted at 5.562 million shillings on 185,667 shares from 7.006 million shillings on 263,043 shares.
A senior broker said apart from Tuesday where the turnover had been boosted by heavy trading on the special board, the week's general trading was sluggish.
"The general pace of the market is slow. Most counters have made their mid-year announcements but these have made a very little impact on the market," he said.
British American Tobacco eased to 68 from 69, Kenya Breweries rose to 46 from 44.50 and Total Kenya gained a shilling to 71.

The markets concentration remained in the Kenya Commercial Bank (KCB) sale of 11.88 primary shares -- a 10 percent stake the government of offloading in the ongoing privatisation programme. The state will retain a 60 percent stake in the bank while 40 percent will belong to the public.
The shares have been offered at 50 shillings each.
"Most institutional investors have moved out of the market and are now concentrating on the primary share issue," a dealer said.
Kenya Commercial Bank held steady at 52.50, Barclays Bank rose to 100 from 98.50 on 14,898 shares and National Bank of Kenya traded 24,575 shares at 16.05 from 16.25.
Among plantations, George Williamson rose to 67.50 from 66, Sasini Tea & Coffee gained to 50.50 from 49 while Rea Vipingo was unchanged at 11 on 23,730 shares.
In commercials, Express Ltd was at 80, Nation Printers & Publishers at 106 and Kenya Airways rose to 10.25 from 10.20 on 42,086 shares.
